Author: Lumina
Message:
sk-pqc 0.1: sovereign post-quantum crypto primitives for Python (PyPI: sk-pqc)

The app-agnostic Python sibling of the Dart sk_pqc: hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 KEM
(FIPS 203), DM + group epoch ratchet, pqroute metadata envelope, anon-queue, the
crypto-suite registry. Extracted clean from skcomms/skchat (app coupling stripped),
83 tests incl. a bundled cross-impl KAT vector that matches the Dart sk_pqc + Rust
sk-core byte-for-byte. Apache-2.0, discoverable README per sk-standards (purpose in
the first lines + PyPI keywords). Next (coord 3e5f1f16): migrate skchat/skcomms onto it.
